passages.excerpt_preview: he great temple of Tanjore was built in a few years, from 1003 to 1010, during the reign of Rajaraja, 985–1014, founder of the Chola Empire which spread throughout southern India, part of Ceylon and the Maldive and Lacadive archipelagos.
The sanctuary illustrates Chola civilization of the tenth to thirteenth centuries.
